prompt:
Image 1 is the floor plan of a room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Image 2 is the front view of the same room (the establishing view), taken from the centre of the front wall facing the back wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this same room, empty of people, from a new camera position: the right-side view: the camera stands at the centre of the left wall, at eye level, facing the right wall, so the front wall is at the right edge of the frame and the back wall at its left edge. Turn the camera for real: this view must not show the back wall's furniture head-on unless it is the wall being faced. Keep every wall, door, window, piece of furniture, material, colour and light exactly as Image 1 and Image 2 show them, seen from this new side; the room layout and furniture placement exactly match Image 1. Location: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE. A sleek, modern, contemporary corner office of a high-end architecture and design firm on a high floor, in warm walnut, black leather and white marble. Back wall: floor-to-ceiling glass windows over a daytime city skyline, the main light source, throwing soft daylight from behind towards the camera. A big walnut executive desk stands centred in front of these windows, facing the camera, with a high-backed black leather chair with padded arms behind it. The desktop holds rolled and spread architectural plans, a fan of wood samples, a small brushed-metal abstract figurine and a pour-over coffee station. Left wall: tall walnut shelving with architectural models and material samples, and at its centre a framed black-and-white typographic sign reading "JUST DO IT." In front of the left wall stands the seating area: a tan leather sofa against the shelving, two tan leather armchairs facing each other, and a low white marble coffee table between them. Right wall: a tall walnut door near the front corner, the way in, and a slim console with a plant next to it. Front wall, behind the camera: a pin-up wall of drawings. The open floor between the desk and the right-wall door is a clear space of pale oak flooring. Additional light comes from warm recessed ceiling spots and a black task lamp on the desk.

Avoid: people, readable text, logos, watermark, any door or window the description does not name.
